entries.047264087559655a: This is a [[term:segment|segment]] engaged in banking and related businesses, consisting of four companies in total: Sony Bank Inc. and three equity-method affiliates. Sony Bank provides deposits (yen and foreign currency), housing loans, investment trusts and foreign exchange margin trading, among others, through the internet. Ordinary revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥129,839 million. Ordinary revenue including intersegment transactions rose 11.0% year on year, as funding income, such as interest on loans and interest and dividends on securities, increased, while housing loan-related service income decreased.

entries.6c7b7a07c473addf: This is a [[term:segment|segment]] engaged in the non-life insurance business, consisting of one company, Sony Assurance Inc. Sony Assurance provides automobile insurance, fire insurance, medical insurance and other products through the internet and by telephone. Ordinary revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥191,320 million. Ordinary revenue including intersegment transactions rose 13.3% year on year, as net premiums written steadily increased, centered on the core automobile insurance.

entries.b9492eb454b0dfe0: This is a [[term:segment|segment]] engaged in the life insurance business, consisting of two companies: Sony Life Insurance Co., Ltd. and Sony Life Communications Inc. Sony Life provides tailor-made life insurance based on detailed consulting by life planners (sales staff) and partners (sales agencies). Segment information is presented in ordinary revenue instead of the sales revenue used by general companies, and the businesses here are listed in descending order of ordinary revenue from external customers. Ordinary revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥2,531,621 million, the largest of the reportable segments. Ordinary revenue including intersegment transactions rose 9.4% year on year, due to increases in foreign exchange gains and reinsurance income.
